user.title: Salto KS
user.description:
Sign in with your Salto KS account. The client ID is sent exactly as entered (`Authorization: Basic <client ID>`).

Last server response: {server_message}

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Salto KS
reauth_confirm.description:
The stored credentials were rejected. Please enter them again.

Last server response: {server_message}

error.invalid_auth: Username or password rejected (invalid_grant). See the server response below.
error.invalid_client: Client ID rejected (invalid_client). See the server response below.
error.unauthorized_client: This client is not allowed to use the password grant (unauthorized_client).
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Salto KS services. See the server response below.

set_easy_office_mode_schedule.name: Set Easy Office Mode schedule
set_easy_office_mode_schedule.description: Changes the Easy Office Mode schedule of one or more Salto KS locks in a single request per lock. Fields that are left out keep their current value.

auto_start.name: Auto start
auto_start.description: Unlock the lock automatically when the window starts.

days.name: Days
days.description: Weekdays on which the schedule applies. Days that are not selected are disabled.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Start of the daily window (local time).

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: End of the daily window (local time); the lock is locked automatically at this time.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day of the schedule (included). Set it to an empty value (null) to remove the end date, so the schedule runs indefinitely. Leave the field out to keep the current end date.

remove_easy_office_mode_schedule.name: Remove Easy Office Mode schedule
remove_easy_office_mode_schedule.description: Removes the Easy Office Mode schedule of one or more Salto KS locks. Locks without a schedule are skipped.
